shell.tagline: Tomorrow's voltage risk on a street with rooftop solar, and the fix that physics confirms.
shell.running: Computing… the first run of a new case takes up to a minute.
shell.footer: Meter data: CEEW smart meters (public domain) · Weather: Open-Meteo · Street layout: SimBench benchmark with Indian overhead wires
home.strip_title: Chance of unsafe voltage, every quarter hour
home.strip_label: Probability of an unsafe step for each quarter hour; highest {max} at {time}
home.legend: Dashed lines: watch at {watch}, act at {act}
home.hours_range: {p10} to {p90} h in most scenarios (P10 to P90)
home.peak_range: {p10} to {p90} V (P10 to P90); the rule allows {vmin} to {vmax} V
home.uncalibrated: Not reliable as odds under this rule: on held-out days these chances did no better than the historical average. Use them to see which hours are riskiest.
home.calibrated: Checked on held-out days: these chances are slightly better than the historical average. They are a guide, not exact odds.
fixes.safe_body: Replayed through the full power flow for every scenario and every quarter hour: no unsafe step remains.
fixes.none_body: Every option tried still leaves unsafe steps under this rule.
fixes.binding_voltage: What stops it: {limit}, up to {value} V against the {bound} V limit, on {steps} quarter hours.
fixes.binding_loading: What stops it: {limit}, loaded to {value}% against {bound}%, on {steps} quarter hours.
fixes.binding_solver: What stops it: the power flow does not converge on {steps} quarter hours, so they count as unsafe.
fixes.closest: Closest option: {label}, with {steps} unsafe quarter hours left.
fixes.baseline: Without any fix: {steps} unsafe quarter hours.
fixes.cost_margin: Smallest voltage margin to the rule: {value} V
fixes.chart_title: Highest voltage on the street, before and after
fixes.chart_label: Highest voltage per quarter hour before and after {label}; the rule allows up to {vmax} V
day.label: Demo day
try.intro: Change the street or the day, add fixes, and run them through the full power flow on the design day (P90 solar of the chosen day). Every number below comes from that run.
try.adoption: Share of homes with solar ({min} to {max})
try.group_change: Change the street or the day
try.result_day: Design day {date}; the rule allows {min} to {max} V.
try.profile_label: Highest voltage over the day at each of {n} points along the street, before and after; the rule allows up to {vmax} V
plan.intro: How much more rooftop solar this street can take, where, and on which phase. Each answer is a power-flow run on the design day of the chosen day and rule.
plan.headroom_base: With {share} of homes on solar, the street already has {steps} unsafe quarter hours on the design day.
plan.headroom_note: "No harm": extra kW that adds no unsafe quarter hour. "Fully safe": extra kW with the whole street safe all day (zero when the street is already unsafe).
plan.caps_title: Flat state caps on this transformer
plan.caps_installed: Solar installed on this street now: {kw} kW. The caps ignore phase and place; the table above does not.
plan.hosting_title: Hosting capacity: share of homes that can have solar
plan.hosting_value: {p50} of homes (P10 {p10} to P90 {p90}), about {kw} kW
plan.hosting_note: Over {draws} random choices of which homes get solar, on which phase and of what size; a level fails if it makes any quarter hour worse.
plan.conn_kw_error: Must be above zero and at most {max} kW.
plan.dec_approve: Approve: {count} × {kw} kW on phase {phase} adds no unsafe quarter hour.
plan.dec_refuse: Refuse: {count} × {kw} kW makes the street worse, and no condition tried fixes it.
plan.dec_largest: Largest size that passes here: {kw} kW.
plan.dec_evidence: Quarter hours the request makes worse: {worse} (street already unsafe on {base}). Per phase: {phases}.
